title: Make our store readable and buyable by AI agents before holiday peak
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); Walmart added agent spending limits; Amazon widened Shop Direct; FTC probes Target, Walmart pricing; Asus sees PC prices up ~10%; Apple showed touchscreen Macs.

points.headline: Retailers are setting the rules for AI shopping agents
points.detail: Walmart added spending limits for agent purchases and Amazon widened Shop Direct to keep discovery in-house. We should define agent access and purchase controls for our store.

points.headline: AI is now a mainstream discovery channel
points.detail: NIQ finds 55% of consumers use AI during discovery; Gartner says 34% of US consumers would use GenAI for gift ideas. Product data quality now matters as much as SEO for us.

points.headline: Memory costs keep PC prices rising while Apple goes touch
points.detail: Asus expects Taiwan commercial PC prices up nearly 10% in 2H26 and Samsung sees no memory relief before 2028; Apple showed touchscreen laptops. We should plan pricing and premium positioning.

points.headline: Pricing scrutiny and longer sales windows shape holiday promotions
points.detail: The FTC ordered Target and Walmart to detail personalized pricing, while Walmart stretched Black Friday and Cyber Monday to 14 days. We should review our deal calendar and personalization practices.
